names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Vadim, arhimandritul».

feast.note: The day page and the life page agree on 9 aprilie as the commemoration, but the life itself says he was killed «în 8 Aprilie»; the day is the calendar's, the 8th is the life's date of death.
